name: Ramp
text: To enhance accessibility in EXCAVA, we should implement a clear focus ring for all interactive elements. name: Reader
text: While a subtle focus ring may reduce visual clutter, the real risk is that it could be insufficient for users with varying visual abilities. A better alternative is to test the effectiveness of a more pronounced focus indicator, perhaps a thicker ring or a combination of color and animation, to ensure all users can easily perceive the focused element. To settle this debate, we should conduct user testing with a diverse group to see which option helps users navigate more effectively.
